name: Toast
summary: Short-lived message after a user action, at the bottom right of the screen. Shares its base with Alert.
use: Error in a background action, with a way to fix it.
avoid: Information the user needs later: use Alert.
anatomy: Same as Alert, with a shadow and its own border.
figmaProps: Gray, Brand, Error, Warning, Success, Info
reactProps: Default 'Notifications'. Live region that holds the toasts.
behaviour: Disappears by itself after a few seconds, except for errors or when it has an action.
Pause the timer on hover and focus.
a11y: Put toasts in a ToastRegion (aria-live="polite"). Render the region always, also when it is empty; a toast has no role of its own.
While a Modal, Slideout or Command menu is open, the region moves into that dialog, so toasts stay visible and are read.
Give people enough time to read (WCAG 2.2.1).
content: Short and in the past tense: "File uploaded".
do: Three toasts at the same time at most, newest at the bottom.
dont: Toasts for errors the user must fix in a form.
open: ToastRegion does not dismiss toasts by itself yet. The app does that for now.
